headline: Khaitan & Co advises on Vedanta's landmark four-way demerger—one of India's largest corporate restructurings with ₹3.50 lakh crore enterprise value—creating four independent listed pure-play entities across aluminium, power, oil & gas, and steel.
sum: Khaitan & Co advised on Vedanta Limited's composite scheme of arrangement demerging into four independent listed entities (aluminium, power, oil & gas, iron & steel). Under a 1:1 vertical split on record date 1 May 2026, shareholders received one equity share in each of the four resulting companies for every Vedanta share held. Consolidated debt of ₹73,853 crore was apportioned by cash-generating capacity; all four entities listed on NSE/BSE on 15 June 2026, unlocking ₹50,000 crore in market value.
implication: Demerger as vertical split with proportionate debt allocation by cash-generating capacity (not equal split) sets precedent for complex multi-subsidiary restructurings; NCLT sanction required settlement of contractual disputes (SEPCO arbitration with Talwandi Sabo Power) before final approval—critical sequencing issue for multi-creditor schemes.
detail: <cite index="1-1,1-2">Vedanta Limited's board formally approved implementation of the composite scheme on 20 April 2026, setting 1 May 2026 as the effective and record date for determining eligible shareholders.</cite> <cite index="1-1,1-4">The demerger created four resulting companies via vertical split: for every one Vedanta share held on record date, shareholders received one equity share each in Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited, Talwandi Sabo Power Limited, Malco Energy Limited, and Vedanta Iron and Steel Limited.</cite> <cite index="40-3">Consolidated debt of approximately ₹73,853 crore was apportioned across resulting entities on the basis of their respective cash-generating capacities.</cite> <cite index="40-4,40-5">The scheme was approved by the National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench, by order dated December 16, 2025, read with order dated January 21, 2026, and all four resulting entities listed on the exchanges on 15 June 2026.</cite>
